text: You just got the worst news of your life, and your chest feels like it's being crushed.
This is broken heart syndrome, and it's real.
A flood of stress hormones like adrenaline hits your heart all at once.
It stuns the main pumping chamber, and the bottom of it balloons out like a pot.
Your heart can't pump right, and it feels just like a heart attack.
Chest pain or trouble breathing is always a call to 911.
Most people heal in a few weeks, but in rare cases, it can kill you.
Send this to someone going through a breakup, and subscribe.
